# Coloured Markdown Notes

This paragraph contains <span style="color: red">red text</span>,
<span style="color: #3478d4">blue text</span>, and
<span style="color: rebeccapurple">purple text</span>.

You can also make <span style="color: forestgreen">**bold green text**</span>.

This file does not need MathJax, so DiscShelf should open it in the **lightweight native reader**.

Literal tags in code remain unchanged:

```html
<span style="color: red">shown as code</span>
```
